programme.title: Love Hostel
programme.desc: Love Hostel is a gritty romantic thriller that explores the dark realities of honor killings in India. The story follows Ashu and Jyoti, a couple from different religious backgrounds who elope to escape the wrath of their families. As they seek a new beginning, they are relentlessly hunted by a ruthless mercenary hired to restore "family honor." Starring Vikrant Massey, Sanya Malhotra, and Bobby Deol, the film is a raw and intense portrayal of love caught in the crossfire of social prejudice and violence. Directed by Shanker Raman, the movie is a chilling commentary on intolerance and the price of defiance.

programme.title: Holiday - A Soldier is Never Off Duty
programme.desc: Directed by A. R. Murugadoss, this action thriller stars Akshay Kumar as Captain Virat Bakshi, who stumbles upon a sleeper cell network during his holiday. Balancing his personal life and duty, he works to prevent a major terrorist attack. The film is a Hindi remake of the Tamil movie Thuppakki.

The story follows Ashu and Jyoti, a couple from different religious backgrounds who elope to escape the wrath of their families. As they seek a new beginning, they are relentlessly hunted by a ruthless mercenary hired to restore "family honor." Starring Vikrant Massey, Sanya Malhotra, and Bobby Deol, the film is a raw and intense portrayal of love caught in the crossfire of social prejudice and violence. Directed by Shanker Raman, the movie is a chilling commentary on intolerance and the price of defiance.

programme.title: Khatta Meetha
programme.desc: Khatta Meetha, directed by Priyadarshan and starring Akshay Kumar and Trisha Krishnan, is a satirical comedy that highlights the absurdities of the Indian bureaucratic system. The film centers around a small-time road contractor who faces numerous hurdles, including red tape, corrupt officials, and family feuds, while trying to complete a government project. Blending humor with social commentary, the movie offers a bittersweet take on systemic flaws and personal perseverance.

programme.title: Simmba

Transforming into a man of justice, Simmba takes on a powerful criminal nexus. With high-octane action, emotional drama, and punchy dialogues, this Rohit Shetty directorial stars Ranveer Singh and Sara Ali Khan in a thrilling narrative of redemption.

programme.title: The Fifth Estate
programme.desc: The top-notch team of hosts Bob McKeown, Gillian Findlay, Mark Kelley and Habiba Nosheen provides unique and engaging documentaries from Canada and beyond. "The Fifth Estate" is a reference to the term Fourth Estate, and was chosen to highlight the program's determination to go beyond everyday news into original journalism. The series has won numerous awards for its reporting, including Gemini Awards, International Emmys, the Michener Award, and even an Academy Award for a 1981 episode that was released in theaters the following year. Since September 1975, Canadians have tuned in to experience interesting stories that are always well-crafted and thought-provoking.

programme.sub-title: From Hippies to the first PC
programme.desc: Todays’ Silicon Valley is the home for multi-million dollar IT companies. In the beginning, however, it was unsophisticated, colourful, chaotic, and revolutionary. Hippies and amateur entrepreneurs initiated an unprecedented revolution: the pioneers of the PC wanted to change the world in an attempt to dethrone the “Big Brother”.

programme.title: Stalin's Daughter
programme.desc: It is a sensation in the midst of the Cold War. Stalin's daughter Svetlana Alliluyeva flees to the West. During her childhood in the center of power, she was Joseph Stalin's favorite child. But death and violence overshadow her life. Her mother and brother die, relatives are killed, Stalin has her lover abducted.

programme.title: Operation Peter Pan - The Secret War against Cuba
programme.desc: In 2016, a historic moment arrived when Barack Obama spoke in Cuba to the inhabitants of the island nation and promised a future together. For the first time in more than 50 years, an American president had entered the communist country and turned towards an erstwhile enemy. However, the US economic embargo against Cuba continues. It sanctions the socialist state – although the UN General Assembly recently again called it a violation of international law. Many Cubans are therefore sceptical about a new political future, despite the friendly words of the American President. Their distrust is deep. It is based on over fifty years of history and the policies of the United States towards their country. For years, the Cuban government has raised serious allegations against their big neighbour. The film "Operation Peter Pan" tracks these allegations.

programme.title: In Search of Santa Claus
programme.desc: The amazing transformation of a holy man from Turkey into the world-wide symbol of Christmas cheer. He's one of the most widely recognized figures in the world; but what are the origins of St. Nicholas, and how did he become Santa Claus? With criminological acumen, this one-hour documentary sorts the myths from the facts to present the true story of the first multi-national saint, revered by the Catholic, Protestant and Orthodox churches alike.

programme.title: The Greater Caucasus
programme.desc: The mountains of the Caucasus form a magical border between Europe and Asia. Film-maker Henry M. Mix and his crew spent over a year in Russia's highest mountains. The result is an impressive documentary about the natural wonders to be found between the Black and Caspian Seas. The wild mountain landscape with its extreme climate has created a unique world of flora and fauna and makes the Caucasus one of the world's 25 most significant centres of biodiversity. Mountain bison, Caucasus Snowcock and tur are only found here. In the rain shadow of the snow-covered main ridge live Saiga antelopes, long-eared hedgehogs and short-toed snake eagles. Epic footage, breath-taking aerial photography and hitherto unseen behaviour of rare animals - Greater Caucasus has its viewers spellbound from the first minute on.

programme.title: The Kaiser's Pirates
programme.desc: In November 1916, German raider SMS Wolf set out for a 15-month long voyage through the oceans finally reaching Australia and Papua New Guinea. The mission of this ship which was perfectly masked as a merchant vessel: capture, sink or destroy allied shipping.

programme.title: Gold for Kim - A Life for North Korea's Leader
programme.desc: North Korea is a country of stark contrasts. On the one hand, it presents real socialist stereotypes like cryptic messages from a frozen time loop, combined with shocking reports on shortages. On the other hand, polished Pyongyang lures with a futuristic skyline, flashy amusement parks and department stores with a range of goods equal to those in western consumer meccas.

programme.title: The Secret of the Phaistos Code
programme.desc: Is the Phaistos Disc a clever fake? The film follows the trail of possibly one of the greatest archaeological scandals ever. The search for the truth starts in the ancient Cretan palace complexes of Phaistos. The North American art dealer Jerome Eisenberg, one of the world’s foremost forgery experts, considers the “Phaistos Disc” to be a latter-day fake. In 1908, it was discovered by the Italian archaeologist Luigi Pernier. Since then, the disc has aroused the scientific ambition of countless linguists. The British academic Gareth Owens has analyzed new archaeological discoveries with unfamiliar characters and believes the disc to be genuine. But Eisenberg remains convinced that the disc cannot be deciphered at all. He claims that not only does it not reveal a text that has ever been decipherable, but also that is not even of ancient origin.

programme.title: The Lesser Caucasus - Between Ararat and the Caspian Sea
programme.desc: The mountain worlds of the Greater and Lesser Caucasus mark the border between Europe and Asia. After their documentary about the Greater Caucasus, Henry J. Mix and his team have now prepared a second film about the impressive mountain world of this region. The species and landscape diversity of the lesser Caucasus are portrayed in Armenia, Georgia and Azerbaijan. Shielded from the more than 4000-metre-tall main ridge of the Greater Caucasus, a thermophilic flora and fauna was able to develop in the Lesser Caucasus. For the first time, the astonishing variety of the land bridge between Europe and Persia is portrayed comprehensively. From the mountains of Dagestan, down to the canyons of the Caspian Basin, through the steppes of Azerbaijan and up into the Armenian highlands, all before the majestic backdrop of biblical Mount Ararat.

programme.title: Adventure Ocean Quest - Season 1
programme.desc: French Polynesia’s great hammerhead sharks are extraordinarily shy animals and still pose many questions, not least where they go during their annual migration. Freediver Frederic Buyle and cameraman Christian Petron team up with scientist Dr. Johan Mourir to investigate these bizarre predators.

programme.title: Adventure Ocean Quest - Season 1
programme.desc: Humpback whales have come back from the brink of extinction, but they are still difficult to approach in the water and their behaviour and vocalisations pose many unsolved questions. Dr. Michael Poole wants to find out if the whales respond differently to a silent freediver compared to conventional divers, and has asked Frederic to dive with the whales and observe them.

programme.title: Font of Life
programme.desc: Starting at Imbak Falls, wildlife photographer Cede Prudente together with boatman Rizal start their journey down Borneo’s longest river ­ the Kinabatangan. Cede is on a mission to photograph the varied wildlife along this river from source to sea. In this episode, we meet some modern day Dusun people, an ethnic group once notorious as headhunters.

programme.title: How the Greeks Changed the World
programme.desc: The Ascent of Civilization is a gripping landmark series with a twist – a fresh look at three ancient trailblazer cultures that have shaped all of our lives. Democracy, science, theatre, plumbing, modern roads, laws, the Olympics, conquering the seas, the discovery of America, and the onset of globalisation … you’d be hard-pushed to find a more eclectic list of achievements. They’re all at the heart of modern society, but their origins were passed down to us through the ages. It’s an inheritance that leads us back to the world of the Ancients – the world of the Greeks, the Romans and the Vikings.

programme.title: The First Victim
programme.desc: Hitler’s Poland Campaign unleashed a “Blitzkrieg” lasting six weeks only. However, it was a war of unprecedented brutality resulting in a tremendous suffering of the Polish people in the long run. Jews were herded into Ghettos; other residents were imprisoned in camps for forced labor or displaced to make way for German settlers. Hundreds and thousands of them became victims of the Nazi murder machine. In part 2, “World War II” sheds light on some of their lives telling almost forgotten stories.

programme.title: The Silicon Valley Revolution - How a few nerds did change the world
programme.sub-title: From the first Computer Trade Fair to the WWW
programme.desc: The dream of personal computers slowly turns into Big Business. The dream of a few leftist visionaries took over the world in the 1980s: the now legendary Macintosh goes on sale, Bill Gates creates the foundation for his economic imperium, the world wide web connects billions of people all over the world, Google is founded.

programme.title: The Human Limits - Season 1
programme.desc: In this part, six talents prove their extraordinary abilities and show how they control their mind. There’s Lukas Irmler who’s slacklining in dizzying heights above the abyss, Shaolin monk Shi Yan Yao who has spent his whole life practicing meditation and can bend a steel bar with his neck and mathematical super brains Gert Mittring and Rüdiger Gramm who can solve nearly every arithmetic problem without a pocket calculator.

programme.title: Alexander The Great - Season 1
programme.desc: Part one of this stunning documentary focuses on Alexander the Great’s childhood and youth. Born in Macedonia in 356 BC as a member of the Argead dynasty, he succeeded his father Philip II to the throne at the age of twenty. But the kingdom Alexander inherited was volatile.

programme.title: Alexander The Great - Season 1
programme.sub-title: Until the End of the World
programme.desc: After the assassination of his father, the young king of Macedonia set out to conquer a massive empire. Against overwhelming odds, Alexander led his army to victories across the Persian territories of Asia Minor, Syria and Egypt finally reaching northwest India – all without suffering a single defeat.

programme.title: The Arabs
programme.desc: The Arabs have been bringing knowledge of the ancient world to Europe since the 8th century. In the fields of medicine, mathematics or philosophy, their scholars were far beyond their time and still affect our world today. For a long time the Arabs were estranged, not united by one nation or leader. They had little in common but a shared language.

programme.title: The Carthaginians
programme.desc: The Carthaginians were sly merchants and cruel child killers – at least according to the Ancient Romans and Greeks. But research shows that they weren’t as bad as their reputation. The Carthaginians’ story began around 3,000 years ago, when settlers left their homes in what is now Lebanon to set up new colonies around the Mediterranean.

programme.title: Speed S1 - "Into the Skies"
programme.desc: Growth in air transportation is set to soar, carrying over 10 billion passengers every year by 2050. To cope requires us to radically rethink aircraft design. Join us as we look into the world's most innovative research and development labs.

programme.title: Speed S1 - "Into Space"
programme.desc: The most innovative area of human motion lies not on Earth, but with the exploration of space. Meet the private space entrepreneurs jostling to offer the tantalizing prospect of cheap, frequent travel beyond the atmosphere into Earth orbit.

programme.title: War Machines S1 - "Ruling The Waves"
programme.desc: From the most deadly submarines ever seen to the infamous destroyers of the Second World War, this episode is the story of what it takes to rule the waves.

programme.title: War Machines S1 - "Conqeuring The Sky"
programme.desc: The evolution of mankind's desire to fly higher, move faster, and kill better all from within the cockpit.

programme.title: War Machines S1 - "Ultimate Annihilation"
programme.desc: Explore the destructive capability of machinery across all scales, the inventions designed to unleash maximum carnage, then and now.

programme.title: Ultimate Processes S1 - "Waterford"
programme.desc: Francesca finds out how the world famous Waterford crystal is made and gets to try out glass blowing and glass cutting with surprising results.

programme.title: Ultimate Processes S1 - "Helicopters"
programme.desc: In this episode of Ultimate Processes, we investigate how the AW 101, one of the world’s most advanced search and rescue helicopters is designed and built.

programme.title: Bright Now S1 - "Asteroid or Alien Tech?"
programme.desc: It was discovered on October 19th, 2017 and it was recognized as the first known object of its type. It is unique since it is the first known object that came from our solar system. But while we observed it, the mystery surrounding it grew.

programme.title: Space Dealers S1 - "Dealers on a Mission"
programme.desc: Larry takes on an impossible mission: he’s been asked to find an item worn in space by Apollo 15 legend Al Worden. Torie searches for Russian space items for a museum in San Francisco and Cole goes on the hunt for an item from Apollo 13.

programme.title: Space Dealers S1 - "Money Trouble"
programme.desc: Larry gets the offer of a lifetime: a Soviet era space suit. Torie pays big for an Apollo 11 artefact but it’s not what it seems. Cole meets Apollo 7 legend Walt Cunningham.

programme.title: Space Dealers S1 - "The Apollo Sale"
programme.desc: Torie’s son Jason joins her on the road. Larry turns ‘gastronaut’ when he comes across some space food; and a collector’s flash sale sees Cole bid for an Apollo 11 item with an incredible story.

programme.title: Space Dealers S1 - "Good Luck, Bad Luck"
programme.desc: Cole gets lucky when he finds a Russian space suit in an old box, but the gloves are missing. To find the gloves he has to strike a deal with Larry. Torie hears how Coke and Pepsi joined the space race and meets former NASA astronaut Winston Scott.

programme.title: Air Wars S1 - "The Eastern Front 1941-45"
programme.desc: The text addresses the conflict between Hitler's Luftwaffe and the Soviet Air Force, highlighting that despite initial outclassing, Stalin's pilots eventually achieved parity with Allied assistance.

programme.title: Air Wars S1 - "The Great Marianas Turkey Shoot"
programme.desc: The Great Marianas Turkey Shoot was an aerial battle in the Western Pacific where the U.S. successfully shot down over 300 Japanese aircraft with a 12-1 kill-to-loss ratio.

programme.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Targeting & Tracking, Navigation, Seagoing Drones"
programme.desc: We reveal an experimental sensor, monitoring and targeting system developed for troops by the UK's Defence Science and Technology Laboratory and Roke Manor Research. The iXblue Marins navigation black box guides navy ships.

programme.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "NATO Maritime Centre, No Shipping-No Shopping"
programme.sub-title: NATO Maritime Centre, No Shipping-No Shopping
programme.desc: We visit NATO's Centre for Maritime Research and Experimentation in La Spezia, Italy. We learn how the world's oceans are one of the last places that military technology can be hidden from prying eyes.

programme.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Terrorist Threats, Sea Wasp Robot, Combat Medics"
programme.sub-title: Terrorist Threats, Sea Wasp Robot, Combat Medics
programme.desc: With an increasing terrorist threat to ports and shipping, the Swedish manufacturer SAAB has developed the Sea Wasp, an under-water robot for detecting explosive devices.

programme.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Warrior Vehicles, British Special Forces"
programme.desc: We're in Scotland for Unmanned Warrior, the key international military exercise using unmanned underwater, surface and airborne vehicles. We visit the Italian textile manufacturer who's kitting from a revolutionary new form of wool.

programme.title: The Age of Robots S1 - "The Humanoid Robots"
programme.desc: They look, they move like us and soon they will live among us. They are humanoid robots.Meet an astonishing group of humanoids,among them: iCub,the world's first baby robot and REEM,the Service Robot,ready to be launched as a guide in public spaces.

programme.title: The Age of Robots S1 - "Bioinspired Robots"
programme.desc: In this episode we look at a robotic plant that mimics the mechanics of plant roots, and dive underwater to see robots inspired by fish.

programme.title: The Age of Robots S1 - "City of the Future"
programme.desc: By the year 2050, three qarters of the world's population will live in urban areas. Looking at robotic systems being developed worlwide we can take a glimpse at the city life of the future.

programme.title: The Age of Robots S1 - "Robot Explorers"
programme.desc: Inhospitable environments that would normally be unreacheble become accessible thanks to Robot Explorers. Robots can help us in difficult tasks but is there any danger in letting machines handle so many tasks that used to belong to us?

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered S1 - "Coup In Crimea"
programme.desc: The Crimea Annexation in February 2014 was the biggest and most blatant land grab in Europe since WWII and shook the very foundations upon which peace in the region had been based ever since. How did Russia execute the annexation?

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered S1 - "Yemen Britain & The Saudis"
programme.desc: In March 2019 news reports appeared in the British press of UK’s troops being killed in Yemen, no one knew why they are there in the first place. Britain was not fighting a war in Yemen. This episode investigates the truth behind the casualties.

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered S1 - "Somalia Pirates & Black Hawkdown"
programme.desc: On the 3 October 1993, an elite battle unit of the US army began a fairly straight-forward mission in Somalia’s capital Mogadishu. Within minutes of reaching their destination, the situation descended into chaos and the mission turned into a battle.

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered S1 - "Battleground Bosnia"
programme.desc: On the 3 March 1992, Bosnia Herzegovina gained its independence from Yugoslavia. Immediately, the Serb-led military units took over large slabs of land and suppressed the other ethnic groups.

programme.title: War Factories S1 - "German Aviation"
programme.desc: The untold secret story of war production that shaped the Second World War, beginning with how the German aviation industry came to dominate the skies of Europe.

programme.title: War Factories S1 - "Krupp"
programme.desc: The story behind the Krupp company, who were responsible for the manufacture of two of Germany's most feared war products - the Panzer Tank and the U-boat.

programme.title: War Factories S1 - "Vickers"
programme.desc: The role played by engineering giant Vickers during the Second World War, including the development of the Spitfire and how the Royal Navy recovered from losing so many warships.

programme.title: Air Wars S1 - "Bomber Offensive: Target Germany"
programme.desc: This review examines the effects of Allied bombing raids on German industry, air defense, and morale during the European skies conflict, including the US's development of long-range fighters.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: Lisa's Mudder Comes For A Visit
programme.desc: Lisa's "Mudder" pays a surprise visit to Lisa and Oliver. Eb good-naturedly introduces her as the Queen of Sicily. As a result, the entire town treats her like royalty. They even go so far as to hold a special day in her honor.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Arnold Ziffel, Hooterville's beloved swine is thought to have rightful claim to a $20,000 fortune. The Birnbacher pork empire has promised that the descendant of the famous weather-predicting pig, Herman, will inherit the vast sum.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver, Lisa and Eb travel to Chicago with Arnold to prove the pig is the rightful heir to the Birnbacher pork empire. Will this pig get rich? Arnold makes a surprising prediction that baffles all, including all the lawyers involved.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: You And Your Big Shrunken Head
programme.desc: When Oliver returns home with Arnold, the citizens in town hold a large reception for Arnold. But when Oliver receives a phone call from a lawyer representing an eccentric relative of the Birnbachers, the riches go into question.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver is mad over the town's dirt road, especially when he finds out that the state set aside money over thirty years ago to fix it. Oliver goes to the Capitol to get the road paved but hits a roadblock when the Ziffels' house must be torn down.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa foretells of a mysterious stranger that will appear into Oliver's life. Enter Tadpole Talbot, Eb's childhood friend who has become a singing sensation. Tadpole has convinced Eb to go out on the road with him and join his band as a roadie.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver become alarmed that the youth of his beloved town, Hooterville is dwindling so he calls an emergency town meeting to prevent them from leaving. The next thing Oliver knows is that his barn has been volunteered for the new youth center.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver is asked to speak at the local high school about his illustrious law career and makes quite an impression on student Kathy Baxter. Oliver must contend with Kathy's fawning as well as her jealous boyfriend is not very happy with Oliver.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Hank Kimball proposes marriage to lady carpenter Ralph Monroe while under the influence of heavy medication. Lisa plans an amazing country wedding only to find out that, Sam, the Justice of the Peace, has forgotten to new his license.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver plants his crops, worrying that they haven't been planted in time for a harvest. Lisa tries to be helpful and mixes up a batch of sour lemonade. Oliver pours out the bitter elixir in the newly planted field, with an unimaginable consequence.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Sam Drucker does not stock any cosmetics in his store, much to the chagrin of Lisa. Lisa decides to set up a "small" display in the store. When the merchandise is delivered, it forces Mr. Drucker to retreat to the front porch.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Mr. Haney discovers an old wish book dating back to 1898 that tells the story of Calvin and Tessie Whittaker who once owned the Douglases' farm and how Calvin traveled to Hollywood to pitch his idea of putting a mouse named Dickey into films.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver and Lisa discover a root cellar under their house and become trapped when it collapses in on them. Their only hope to get rescued rides on a hilarious game of charades between Arnold the pig and Mr. Drucker.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver goes to New York to finish up a case at his old firm. Meanwhile back on the farm, Lisa and Eb find a puppy left on the doorstep. Lisa, in all her innocence, leads Oliver to believe the puppy, affectionally named Freddie, is a human baby.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver has been invited to give a speech at the Bar Association. He is there to advocate for the hiring of ex-convicts. He eventually ends up regretting his speech when he is forced to hire an ex-convict by the name of Willie Dunhill.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver's crops are getting stomped on by Irene the cow. In his frustration, he fires a shotgun to scare Irene away. Instead the blast leads to a hilarious misunderstanding among Lisa, Eb and a life-sized fiberglass cow.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver has become the new School Board President. Unfortunately, Oliver's first day on the job is anything but smooth. Arnold the pig is expelled from his duties as the school's mascot, and Fred Ziffel implores Oliver to defend Arnold.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: The Case Of The Hooterville Refund Fraud
programme.desc: After receiving a tax refund from the IRS, Oliver inspires his fellow citizens to make similar requests. There's only one problem... those making requests haven't paid their taxes! Nevertheless, the IRS mistakenly sends out half a million dollars!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver is insistent that he and Lisa have a romantic Sunday afternoon picnic, all alone. His romantic gesture for two turns into a picnic for the entire town. Finally, Oliver finds them a romantic refuge in a most unlikely place.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Local boy Dinky Watson has one heck of a story to tell anyone who will listen. When Dinky convinces Lisa to buy a "moon rock" for the considerable sum of $14, Oliver suspects that she is the victim of a practical joke.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When Lisa's Uncle Fedor comes to visit her at the farm, he is visibly upset. He claims that someone is following him. Indeed, Fedor is convinced that the Secret Police are out to steal back a valuable scientific formula, which only he knows.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When Eb places an ad in a magazine claiming to be a wealthy landowner, it catches the eye of a young socialite. When the young woman makes an unexpected visit to Hooterville, Eb is forced to keep up his ruse.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver is upset when he finds out Arnold the pig and he share the same birthday. Jealous that Arnold is getting more attention than he is, Oliver becomes convinced that Lisa is throwing him a surprise party and drives all over town in search for it.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver and Lisa play host to four children from the city, who find themselves in Hooterville as part of a rural exposure program. The kids learn how to milk the cow, pick vegetables, plant seeds, and share sleeping quarters with four-legged friends.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Little Lori Baker, who after coming to stay with the Douglases on a rural experience program, is staying on at the Douglas farm. This city girl, like Oliver, has found that she loves the country life! Lisa decides to throw Lori a welcome party.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa tells a rather fanciful version of how she met and fell in love with Oliver. The Douglases' house guest, little Lori Baker from the city, is all ears. The tale begins with how Lisa's father, the king, was exiled, causing Lisa to flee to Paris.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: The residents of Hooterville assume that Oliver Douglas must be broke when Lisa is spotted looking for work and standing in line at the soup kitchen. But assumptions in this town, even logical ones, are bound to be wrong.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: There is the old adage that warns never to discuss politics with your spouse... but what if you are both running for the same office?! That predicament comes true when Oliver and Lisa face each other in the Hooterville mayoral election.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa and Oliver try to sort out of the troubles of fools in love. The problems begin when Eb invites both his girlfriend and another young woman to the same dance, while Arnold the pig falls for not one, but two attractive bovines.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver is having a tough time. He has no one to help him pick the apples from his orchard, and he's promised to teach Lisa how to drive. The neighbors are all injured from assisting other harvests, and Lisa has a run-in with a sheriff.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Eb feels the time is right to settle down and marry Darlene. However, he has nowhere near the money it will take to make a down payment on a house. With the help of the Douglases, who have given him two acres of land, Eb applies for a loan.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Eb believes he has found his destiny when an accounting course he has enrolled in turns out to be acting workshop. All the world's a stage. Ed dives into acting and turns every simple interaction at the Douglas farm into a starring role.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: After Lisa attends a Women's Liberation League meeting, she gives Oliver a scolding for denying her equal rights and demands to swap chores. While Lisa does a stellar job at Oliver's work, Oliver's attempts at hers leave something to be desired.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver refuses to take Lisa to New York City to attend the wedding anniversary of an old friend. Meanwhile, Eb, always up to something, has a new invisible friend named Charlie. To get her way, Lisa introduces her own invisible friend... Natasha.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa gives the financially-challenged Eb her engagement ring to present to Darlene, his longtime sweetheart, so that he can pop the question. The ring is reportedly valued at $2,000, however, when Darlene's father has it appraised, it's a shocker.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: The Douglases are offered a free paint job on their house and barn so long as they allow the paint company free advertising on their barn wall. Meanwhile, Lisa tries to make spaghetti for Oliver's upcoming birthday. Will it prove im-pasta-ble?

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa hosts the son of WWII hero Drobny, and all of Hooterville gets excited in anticipation of a surge of tourists. Trouble is, this hero was a duck, as is his son. Oliver tried to warn everyone they were making too much fuss over feathers.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Young lovers Eb and Darlene are just weeks away from their wedding day, but they must choose the marriage venue. It's hard to decide between a church and a car wash. At least it is for Eb, who is still looking for a way to pay for it all.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: While staying with the Douglases, Arnold the Pig witnesses a bank robbery when he goes with the Douglases on an errand in Pixley. When Lisa asks him to describe the two robbers, Arnold, reliving the moment, loses his voice from fear.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa worries about Drobny the duck when the water fowl stops eating and sleeping and suffers headaches. Eb suggests the duck needs a duck girlfriend. Lisa agrees and goes about town trying to the right partner for Drobny.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver refuses to take Lisa to the annual Carpenter's Ball because he thinks the attendees are too eccentric for his liking. But Lisa has her own motives to attend. She is trying to get a romance sparked between two local singles.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When Oliver decides to attend night school and enrolls in a farming class, Lisa does the same, taking psychology. Before long, many of the residents of Hooterville are lining up for appointments with the eminent Dr. Lisa.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Aloha! The Douglases vacation in Hawaii. But the daughter of the hotel manager needs to keep secret that she double booked the honeymoon suite. The "sweet" surprise? While Lisa and Oliver settle in, they are unaware that the other room is occupied.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver's heirloom watch is broken so he tries to find his ex-secretary Carol's address to ask her the name of the jeweler who fixed it last time. Carol is now working and living in Los Angeles, and we get a glimpse into her new life.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: In this classic series' premiere episode, New York City attorney Oliver Wendell Douglas (Eddie Albert) satisfies his desire for the simple life by buying a farm, much to the chagrin of his wife, Lisa (Eva Gabor). John Charles Daly narrates the tale!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: Lisa's First Day On The Farm
programme.desc: Oliver (Eddie Albert) brings his wife, Lisa (Eva Gabor), to their new home, a ramshackle farm near Hooterville, just outside of Pixley, where she gets to meet the town's oddball residents. Bea Benaderet, Edgar Buchanan and Frank Cady guest star!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver (Eddie Albert) is ready to get farming, but Lisa (Eva Gabor) puts her foot down and says she will leave unless they can hire a decorator to fix the house! Meanwhile, Kate Bradley (Bea Benaderet) teaches Lisa how to make "hotscakes."

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Is the Honeymoon period over already? The rumor mill has it that Lisa (Eva Gabor) has packed up and left Oliver (Eddie Albert). Actually, she went back to New York to close up their penthouse apartment. And Mr. Haney is up to his old tricks!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver (Eddie Albert) calls in a roofer, a plumber and agricultural expert Hank Kimball (Alvy Moore). All of them give the same appraisal of his farm: it's a disaster! Meanwhile, Mr. Haney (Pat Buttram) has a few chickens he'd like to rent out!

programme.title: Hometown Tragedy
programme.sub-title: Hometown Tragedy: A Mother's Nightmare: The Desperate Search for Cupcake
programme.desc: Three-year-old Kamille McKinney, affectionately known as "Cupcake," is abducted while playing outside a relative's Birmingham home. The ensuing search unifies the city, as residents pray she will be found alive.

programme.title: Hometown Tragedy
programme.sub-title: Hometown Tragedy: A Single Father's Life-Saving Last Act
programme.desc: Single father Kendal Fenwick is the 295th homicide in Baltimore in 2015. Family and investigators wonder whether his efforts to curb drugs and violence in his neighborhood made him a target. Or is it something else entirely?

programme.title: Hometown Tragedy
programme.sub-title: Hometown Tragedy: The Football Star Shooting

programme.title: Local Love

programme.desc: Single Samuel is a man on the move looking to find the right woman to settle down with and start a family in Sacramento. He’s in for a treat with a trip to a goat farm, a loop around a rollerskating rink and a very revealing art experience.

programme.title: Chaos & Kindness
programme.sub-title: Chaos & Kindness: Crazy Basketball Shot and Bringing Joy to Cancer Warriors
programme.desc: Justin and Ryan drum up joy at Hope Lodge, delighting the dedicated staff and energizing patients. In Greenville, locals try for cash during a basketball challenge. A resourceful couple's resilience is rewarded.

programme.title: Eat Play Stay

programme.title: What's On The Menu?

programme.desc: Indulge in the old-school classics that have reigned in the Midwest for decades. From Wisconsin cheese curds to Kansas City's burnt ends, enjoy these unique comfort foods that are as timeless as they are tasty.

programme.title: Hometown Tragedy

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

Each episode is planned to last for 5 minutes (a version without insets – 4 minutes). Technique of performance is 3D computer graphics imitating paper application work.

programme.desc: The lively adventures of a little girl, the carefree, joyful and occasionally perky Fatou, and an alien, the clumsy Roger, on a tropical island… Throughout their adventures, they trigger small accidents that sometimes grow into major disasters, but (almost) always end on a happy note. In short, Roger and Fatou spend their time saving the island from their own mistakes and blunders.

programme.title: Ollie! The Boy Who Became What He Ate
programme.desc: Ollie is a 6-year-old with a massive imagination, often lost in his own world - flipping, sliding, climbing and rocket-blasting through the house, practicing at being the master of all things. But even masters need to stop and refuel. When meals or snack time interrupt Ollie’s play, he finds himself confronted with the real challenge of childhood; trying new food. To escape his predicament, Ollie uses his magic spoon to transport himself, along with his sister Poppy, and her stuffy Nummy, to a food planet filled with adventure and the very food Ollie stuck his spoon into.

programme.title: Camp Cool Kids
programme.desc: At their summer camp competition games, Spence and his big brother Zach find themselves on opposing teams: it’s the dweebs against the bullies. Can Spence make new friends, overcome his fears, stand up to the bullies and win a trophy in the process?

programme.title: Paper Tales
programme.desc: Animation series “Paper Tales” narrate to children audience in fascinating way amusing adventures of paper animals – a moose named Aristotle and a woodpecker named Knock-Knock – in paper land where everything is made only from paper. Merry adventures come together with entertaining insets “for crafty hands” when the audience learns how to produce all cartoon characters using paper, cardboard, scissors and glue. The project is supported with the site where all flat patterns are provided with the advices how to manufacture the paper world items.This is the way spectator gets involved into a peculiar game that brings out creative work and development of many useful practical skills, distracting kids from permanent attachment to a computer. The “Paper Tales” project is a fascinating and helpful alternative to computer-oriented pastime. The whole cartoon is accompanied by off-screen narrator’s text and exuberant flow of gags. Each episode is planned to last for 5 minutes (a version without insets – 4 minutes). Technique of performance is 3D computer graphics imitating paper application work.

programme.title: Future Card Buddyfight
programme.desc: It is the year 2030, and the stage is the capital of Japan, Chou-Tokyo. Through "Buddyfight", humans have started cultural interactions with residents from other worlds called "Affinity Dimensions". Buddyfight is a game with selected humans as the "Buddyfighter", and residents from the other world as the partner (known as "Buddy Monster"). These battles have high significance and sometimes it is even used to decide the fate of a nation, and naturally there are those who seek to use the Buddy Monsters for evil purposes.

programme.title: Sox A Family's Best Friend
programme.desc: When two families come together by marriage, the new brothers struggle to unite and are eventually brought together by a magical dog named Sox.

programme.title: VIP Pets

programme.title: Valentina
programme.desc: Valentina and her friends are fun-loving, teenage girls. They shop, they have sleepovers, and they dream about their first true love.

programme.desc: A 9-year-old boy moves to a lakeside village and befriends a captain who claims a mythical sea creature named Nessie lives in their peaceful waters. When Nessie proves to be real, the boy embarks on a special mission to save the town!

programme.title: Winx Club
programme.desc: Winx Club is a fantasy saga revolving around six fairies and their adventures. The protagonists Bloom, Stella, Flora, Aisha, Tecna and Musa live their daily life on Magix world, among lessons, loves, quarrels and moments of strong friendship. At any moment, when needed, they can transform into super-heroines, ready to defeat evil and save who is in danger.

programme.title: Woodventures
programme.desc: "Woodventures" is an animated series for preschool children. The main characters are wooden toys: Kitty Meow, Doggy Woof-Woof, Piggy Oink, Horsey Yee-Ho-Ho and Elephant Pawoo. The toys live in a small wooden town (the prototype of a child's play room). Every toy has its own unique personality and reacts to different circumstances appropriately. With the help of the invisible narrator, the toys, along with the audience solve different tasks, play and take part in adventures. "Woodventures" is a musical series with lots of songs and dances. Some of the songs represent our characters and appear in each series, and some of the songs are related to the events in the series, so it is only found in that particular episode.Each episode presents a playful and learning environment.

programme.title: Cutie Cubies
programme.desc: An animation series about the adventures of four aliens - Cubies: Captain, Boatswain, Navigator, and Doctor. Having arrived on our planet and disguised as representatives of the local flora and fauna of the cubic form: a yellow chicken, a red rabbit, a blue aquarium and a bush of green grass, they are learning the diverse phenomena of our planet Earth.

programme.title: Bat Pat
programme.desc: The series follows the comedy adventures of Bat Pat and the Silver brothers Martin, Leo and Rebecca as they unravel mysteries and cross paths with supernatural creatures of the night that lurk, haunt, shriek and dig themselves up in every dark corner of their home in Fogville, a small town that seems to be the center of all things weird in the world, a veritable magnet to ghosts, mummies, witches, creatures, werewolves and things that go bump in the night. Bat Pat will prove that the supernatural isn’t always evil but just misunderstood. Our heroes will come to understand something important: the supernatural “bad guys” are not really bad, but normal people whose actions are misunderstood by the more inhabitants of Fogville and what they really want is... just help!

programme.title: Mission to the Moon
programme.desc: In the international race to the moon, the Norwegian mission is led by brilliant inventor Reodor from the village of Flaklypa. With Louis the Magpie as the brave astronaut, what could possibly go wrong? Quite a bit, actually – on the daring mission, secret passengers are discovered, hidden agendas are revealed, and nothing seems to work out the way it was planned. Louis and his friend Luca the Hedgehog are in for some surprises on their trip to the moon. The third film in the stop-motion trilogy featuring the beloved characters from the Flaklypa universe.

programme.title: Spy Cat
programme.desc: Four crazy anti-heroes, one pawsome adventure. Join special-agent Marnie and her friends as they team up and fight crime. Spoiled and innocent, chubby house cat Marnie lives a comfortable and pampered life in the Sunshine household. She has never ventured outside the family home and only knows about the real world through her favourite detective, crime TV-shows.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy Lupin manages to convince the pack elders to let him sit Howlington Academy’s entrance test. Freddy must use all his poodle wits- and his best friend Batty’s help!- to win a place at the historically wolf-only academy.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: It’s the first day of school, and Freddy immediately comes into conflict with bully Ivan, who blackmails him into stealing the sacred moonstone! But when Batty is exposed to the moonstone, she’s turned into a human girl!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy attempts to teach Batty how to be human, while searching for a cure for her new form. A class assignment to capture the mysterious ‘Golden Horn’ and prove who the ‘alpha’ wolf is goes awry when a wilderwolf attacks!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy becomes convinced that there’s a wilderwolf at Howlington, and launches a daring investigation to prove that it’s the school accountant, Mr Sminch. Howlington gets a new teacher, the super cool and charming Ric Rawls.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: The kids are struck down by a flea infestation, and Freddy and Batty are tasked with tracking down the mysterious Doog, keeper of the Fleaminator, the most powerful flea treatment known to dog, before they’re all expelled!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: The kids head out on their first excursion to Night Patrol HQ. Freddy gets pulled into Scarlet’s world as she gets closer to the truth about werewolves and the two bond when they get stuck in the forest while tracking a wolf.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: It’s Howloween, and Howlington is on lockdown. But when the students stage a play that goes wrong and the lockdown is disrupted, it will be up to the kids to save the grown-ups from themselves - including Principal Pincus!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy and Ivan have failed their runes exam and have to do it over - or they won’t be allowed to attend the Doom Wolves concert. But their study session ends up putting themselves, and the Doom Wolves, in grave danger!

The ranks of the fruit-obsessed include adventurers, scientists, fruit detectives and even movie star Bill Pullman, fruit hunters dedicating themselves to searching for and saving rare and exotic fruit, and to creating a Garden of Eden in a world increasingly dominated by industrialized monoculture.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Birth Of A Guitar Part 1
programme.desc: "This is a Wood Whisperer first: a series featuring an aspiring luthier, Rick Urschel. Rick takes us through the process of building a classic guitar from a kit available at LMII.com. This is Rick’s first attempt at a guitar, and as such, I am not presenting this as a “how-to”. Instead, this is just one man’s experience as he works his butt off making a beautiful guitar for his wife. I think you are really going to enjoy it. A special thanks to Rick for allowing me to “Whisperize” his content!"

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Birth Of A Guitar Part 2
programme.desc: Rick continues on his journey into the world of guitar-building. He takes us through adding kerfing, inlaying the tail wedge, installation of the binding, and construction of the back, the soundboard, the fretboard, and the bridge. We’ll also see how Rick handles a few errors he made along the way. One error is so big, the fate of the entire project hangs in the balance!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Birth Of A Guitar Part 3
programme.desc: The exciting conclusion to Rick’s adventure into the world of lutherie. Rick does an incredible job recovering from his previous, nearly disastrous mistake. He takes us through the final assembly as well as his finishing process, which involves a number of techniques including pore-filling, French polish, and wiping varnish. Congratulations to Rick and a huge thank you for letting me tear up your video footage. I know more than a few folks have been inspired to dive into the wonderful world of instrument-making.

programme.desc: The production story of 'KINGKONG,' where TREASURE burned with passion amidst their busy tour schedule.

programme.title: TREASURE - The Mysterious Class
programme.sub-title: TREASURE - The Mysterious Class: S1 E1
programme.desc: The students of TREASURE High School Grade 12 – Class 4 run away in panic when a mysterious force apparently responded to their late-night classroom seance and, in their rush to escape, discover their homeroom teacher lying unconscious in the stairwell. Class president Do-young soon realizes that the result of the séance might be true after learning that their class of 21 is supposed to have 20 students only.

programme.title: TREASURE - The Mysterious Class
programme.sub-title: TREASURE - The Mysterious Class: S1 E2
programme.desc: Class 4 becomes unnerved when a spooky voice resounds from Ye-dam's music demo. Do-young declares his strong opinion that they have to expel the ghost from their homeroom while paranormal geek Hyun-suk, one of the main participants of the séance, starts carrying out his plans to expose the ghost's identity.

programme.title: TREASURE - The Mysterious Class
programme.sub-title: TREASURE - The Mysterious Class: S1 E3
programme.desc: Upon being suspected as the class' resident ghost, an annoyed Asahi proves his classmates wrong with an irrefutable evidence of his innocence. Jae-hyuk secretly obtains a bujeok talisman from Yoshi's shaman grandmother to counter a baleful presence that has affected his academic performance.

programme.title: TREASURE - The Mysterious Class
programme.sub-title: TREASURE - The Mysterious Class: S1 E4
programme.desc: Jae-hyuk asks Yoshi if they could put another bujeok inside their homeroom. Jung-hwan resorts to filming "paranormal activity" that he had secretly contrived to cause fear among his classmates, desperate to gain more online following.

programme.title: TREASURE - The Mysterious Class
programme.sub-title: TREASURE - The Mysterious Class: S1 E5
programme.desc: Class 4 sets up a haunted house booth for the school's spring festival. To save their booth, Haruto uses his powers to haunt the school building.

programme.title: TREASURE - The Mysterious Class
programme.sub-title: TREASURE - The Mysterious Class: S1 E6
programme.desc: Suspicions rise among Class 4 students who start pointing fingers at each other, thinking the ghost intended to harm Jeong-woo. Haruto tries apologizing in person to Jeong-woo, who became mute due to trauma, but to no avail.

programme.title: TREASURE - The Mysterious Class
programme.sub-title: TREASURE - The Mysterious Class: S1 E7
programme.desc: Haruto is forced to admit his identity and reveal his tale to Class 4, but many of them do not believe in his innocence. Class 4 remains divided on whether nor not to evict Haruto from the homeroom.

programme.title: TREASURE - The Mysterious Class
programme.sub-title: TREASURE - The Mysterious Class: S1 E8
programme.desc: Class 4's homeroom teacher orders Haruto's desk to be taken out of the classroom and imposes a penalty to those who attempt to talk to Haruto or even just mention his name. Haruto ultimately loses his visibility and physical form but continues showing care to his classmates.

programme.desc: LA; Jisoo trying out some English; Rosé and nachos; lots of interviews; NY; The Late Show; shopping at Target; Good Morning America; and Happy Birthday Rosé.

programme.title: BLACKPINK Diaries
programme.desc: Macao; Lisa's weird singing; flight to Australia; Jisoo calling Lisa as 'Lali'; Rosé already in Melbourne giving a tour of her Jr. High favorite places; Jisoo has Dalgomie socks; Rod Laver Arena; and Lisa at the aquarium.

programme.title: BLACKPINK Diaries

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Abrumado por la responsabilidad de entrenar a un nuevo rampie y luchando por salir de la caseta del perro de Joe.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Después de tomar el mando de un puente aéreo intenso y lidiar con la carga de Electra más fea que jamás haya visto.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: A solo unos meses de jubilarse, el capitán de Electra, Ray Weber, dirige a su tripulación en una misión de varios viajes.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Cuando los compradores surcoreanos vienen a Buffalo para ver un bombardero de agua.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Buffalo tiene que llevar un bombardero de agua CL-215 a los compradores de Corea.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: En Corea del Sur, Cory y Justin se encuentran con el barco que entrega el avión bombardero acuático de Buffalo a nuevos compradores allí.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Cuando llega la primavera y se acerca el día de la jubilación de Ray, Sean sorprende a todos al dejar Buffalo por un trabajo con la competencia.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Joe y Mikey alquilan un helicóptero para una misión de rescate para recuperar el raro cordal de un Lockheed 10-A.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Justin y Cory están varados en Croacia mientras intentan completar la entrega de dos bombarderos de agua CL-215 a Turquía.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: El copiloto novato Scott se enfrenta a su peor pesadilla cuando un motor Curtiss C-46 Commando y una baja niebla obligan a un aterrizaje aterrador. El joven y ambicioso volador Alex debe demostrar su valía cuando el piloto principal de Buffalo le da el control del Douglas DC-4 de 20 toneladas por primera vez.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: La Navidad está a la vuelta de la esquina, pero la comida y el correo cruciales de Buffalo se detienen. Una incautación del motor deja a Scott, AJ y el avión C-46, creando una reacción en cadena caótica. El crujiente mecánico Chuck debe intentar un cambio de motor con las manos desnudas en menos 30, y la presión de los clientes y compañeros de trabajo empuja al gerente de carga Kelly.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Cuando una falla de energía deja a Rankin Inlet expuesto a los elementos brutales del norte, el capitán Justin corre para entregar un generador de emergencia. El ayudante de rampa Jeremy intenta adelantarse a la compañera de trabajo Audrey entrenando a un nuevo empleado de la India para reemplazarlo. Y cuando la recesión pisa los talones de Joe, intenta negociar un acuerdo de $ 7 millones.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: El mecánico Cory corre contra el reloj para convertir dos bombas de agua de corto alcance en aviones transatlánticos para el viaje épico a Turquía. Depende del ingeniero Adam sacar a la tripulación del C-46 de un atasco en una pista de aterrizaje remota en menos 40. Y cuando el capitán Devan y el copiloto Scott encuentran la amenaza de la cizalladura del viento en el famoso Bear Rock.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Un vuelo charter cae por las grietas después de que los McBryans asisten a una boda familiar salvaje, y un furioso Joe saca al capitán Justin de los vuelos de prueba de Turquía para hacer el trabajo. La tarea de Justin es trasladar a un británico impaciente, su perro y todas sus posesiones mundanas a un remoto puesto avanzado del norte, pero el clima no está cooperando.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Un furioso Joe lucha contra una suspensión federal que le impedirá transportar pasajeros por primera vez en 20 años. También es un revés para Jeremy y las otras rampas, que empeora con una lesión inesperada. Para el equipo de waterbomber de Turquía, finalmente es una oportunidad.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: La tripulación de Turquía hace el salto crítico sobre el Atlántico Norte. Pero en el camino a Portugal, un equipo se ve obligado a regresar. Sin potencia en un motor y sin forma de mantener la altitud, deben regresar a Santa María, donde el aeropuerto está en alerta de emergencia completa. Y Mikey y Scott buscan una nueva rampie, mientras que las esperanzas de Jeremy se desploman aún más.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Las tripulaciones C-46 y DC-4 compiten contra el deshielo primaveral para volar equipos mineros a una pista de aterrizaje en un lago congelado. Jeremy intenta alcanzar a sus compañeros rampies Audrey y Wilf. Y en el último tramo a Turquía, Arnie y Justin se enfrentan a algunos volcanes serios y al intenso tráfico aéreo del Mediterráneo.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Después de miles de horas de preparación minuciosa y vuelo peligroso, un terrible accidente devasta a la tripulación de los bombarderos de agua en Turquía, y a todos en Buffalo. La primera carrera de Wilf como azafata levanta las cejas entre el personal. Y un aficionado a los aviones escoceses cumple el sueño de su vida cuando Joe lo deja viajar en el asiento del capitán de su DC-3.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Cuando su esposo renuncia después de un reventón con Joe, Kelly se pone en una posición terrible. ¿Se quedará en Buffalo o se irá? Scott recibe la noticia de que debe retirarse del vuelo para que otro copiloto pueda acelerar el paso al capitán. Él hace todo lo posible para asegurar una nueva carta, pero su rival también quiere volar el nuevo trabajo.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Joe pelea una demanda de Transport Canada contra la aerolínea.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Cuando un incendio mortal destruye un puesto de avanzada en el norte una semana antes de Navidad.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: La maldición del -40 golpea a los pilotos de Buffalo, Devan y Scott, en un vuelo por correo de alimentos.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Mikey va en busca del tesoro a Venezuela en busca de un raro waterbomber CL-215.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.sub-title: No Te Metas Con Chuck Adam
programme.desc: El mecánico crujiente Chuck lidera la lucha para preparar a los Electra para una misión de socorro en casos de desastre en Haití.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Una misión de varias paradas al Extremo Norte tiene a Devan, Scott y Adam enfrentando una serie de obstáculos de nudillos blancos.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Los jóvenes pilotos AJ y Andrew tienen la oportunidad de su vida de volar el magnífico DC-3.

programme.title: The Matchmaker

programme.title: I'm in Love with a Church Girl
programme.desc: Miles Montego has it all - cars, boats, good looks, mansion, money, women, but more importantly, he has a past. Miles is a retired high-level drug trafficker who is now completely legitimate. Even though Miles has turned over a new leaf, the DEA can't seem to let him out of their sights. Miles' only downfall is that he is extremely loyal to his circle of friends and former colleagues who are not retired from the lucrative business. Struggling to keep on the right side of the law, Miles meets the girl of his dreams, but she's not the usual type of girl that he's used to dating. Vanessa is a church girl in every sense of the word. They are tested to their last ounce of faith and strength in God and each other. God continues to chip away at Miles through struggles from his past, having to live up to his reputation, feelings of unworthiness, the death of his mother, federal charges, his friends being indicted, the strain on his relationship with Vanessa, almost losing her in a near-fatal car accident, and finally the spiritual breakdown and one on one with God that brings Miles to his knees.

programme.title: Partners of the Heart

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Italy is one of the very few nations in the world that regularly gets three major extreme natural phenomena – volcanos, flooding, and avalanches. Eastern flanks of the volcano to slip by up to two metres, and many houses on the flanks of the volcano experienced structural damage. The eruption also completely destroyed the Rifugio Sapienza, on the southern flank of the volcano. The Rifugio was the site of a cable car station which had previously been destroyed in the 1983 eruption; both have now been rebuilt. The most recent eruption was in November 2006.

programme.title: Un Esposo para Estela
programme.desc: Estela Morales es una joven huérfana dueña de una hacienda en ruinas y llena de deudas llamada "El Vendaval". Al morir su madre, Estela descubre que necesita un esposo para poder cobrar la herencia.

programme.title: Hechizo de Amor
programme.desc: Ligia Valderrama (Emma Rabbe) es la hermosa y engreída hija de una familia adinerada que vive en la capital. Pero existen secretos que yacen bajo la fachada de una familia feliz. La mujer que ella considera su madre no es la que le dio la vida, y su verdadera madre está internada en un manicomio. A algunas horas de camino del hogar de Ligia vive otra bella mujer con un pasado diferente. Ella es una pobre huérfana criada por una pareja que la adoptó cuando sus padres murieron. Ambas mujeres conocen y se enamoran de los hombres de sus sueños, pero a ninguna se le permite casarse. En cambio, ambas parejas son obligadas a separarse y por un tiempo pareciera que ambas jóvenes se casarían con la pareja de la otra.

programme.title: Harina de Otro Costal
programme.sub-title: Episodio 33: El Dilema de la Convivencia
programme.desc: La cita de Ángeles y Edén es un desastre, con ella controlando todo. Las madres Carmencita y Maigualida inician una nueva guerra por la junta de condominio.

programme.title: Las Amazonas
programme.desc: Emiro Lizárraga es un ambicioso y orgulloso propietario de un rancho de caballos llamado Amazonas. Emiro obtuvo su fortuna por medios ilegales, y tiene tres hijas Isabel, Carolina y Eloísa, además de haberse casado recientemente con su secretaria Elvira, una mujer coqueta, calculadora y ambiciosa. Las niñas no se llevan bien con la nueva esposa de su padre, lo que provoca conflictos. Isabel, la hija mayor, se siente atraída por Rodrigo, un joven veterinario divorciado y con dos hijas

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, María Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandonó a las dos mucho tiempo atrás para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de María Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que también tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relación extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. María Antonieta fallece después de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: La Vida Entera
programme.desc: Salvador decide llamar por teléfono a Julieta, para agradecerle lo que le había contado acerca del falso secuestro de su padre. Julieta muy contenta le agradece su llamado y le dice que le gustaría que vuelva a confiar en ella para poder hablar juntos sobre su relación algún día. Salvador no sabe si podrá volver a confiar en Julita. Ella mientras tanto, está decidida a demostrarle su inocencia y quiere mostrarse por completo ante Salvador. Máximo y Primitiva la apoyan totalmente en su decisión. Una vez ya casi finalizado el evento Natalia, Facundo y Lupe deciden retirarse, Natalia con el corazón roto por ver a Miky y a Mariví juntos. Mientras esperan el automóvil, Lupe se encuentra con Laly y con Titina nuevamente.

programme.title: Un Esposo para Estela
programme.desc: Estela Morales es una joven huérfana dueña de una hacienda en ruinas y llena de deudas llamada "El Vendaval". Al morir su madre, Estela descubre que necesita un esposo para poder cobrar la herencia.

programme.title: Hechizo de Amor
programme.desc: Ligia Valderrama (Emma Rabbe) es la hermosa y engreída hija de una familia adinerada que vive en la capital. Pero existen secretos que yacen bajo la fachada de una familia feliz. La mujer que ella considera su madre no es la que le dio la vida, y su verdadera madre está internada en un manicomio. A algunas horas de camino del hogar de Ligia vive otra bella mujer con un pasado diferente. Ella es una pobre huérfana criada por una pareja que la adoptó cuando sus padres murieron. Ambas mujeres conocen y se enamoran de los hombres de sus sueños, pero a ninguna se le permite casarse. En cambio, ambas parejas son obligadas a separarse y por un tiempo pareciera que ambas jóvenes se casarían con la pareja de la otra.

programme.title: Harina de Otro Costal
programme.sub-title: Episodio 33: El Dilema de la Convivencia
programme.desc: La cita de Ángeles y Edén es un desastre, con ella controlando todo. Las madres Carmencita y Maigualida inician una nueva guerra por la junta de condominio.

programme.title: Las Amazonas
programme.desc: Emiro Lizárraga es un ambicioso y orgulloso propietario de un rancho de caballos llamado Amazonas. Emiro obtuvo su fortuna por medios ilegales, y tiene tres hijas Isabel, Carolina y Eloísa, además de haberse casado recientemente con su secretaria Elvira, una mujer coqueta, calculadora y ambiciosa. Las niñas no se llevan bien con la nueva esposa de su padre, lo que provoca conflictos. Isabel, la hija mayor, se siente atraída por Rodrigo, un joven veterinario divorciado y con dos hijas

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, María Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandonó a las dos mucho tiempo atrás para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de María Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que también tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relación extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. María Antonieta fallece después de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.
